Message-passing (variational, mean-field) Bayesian multivariate linear
regression of the birth-weight z-score on the HELIX pregnancy exposome
with `RxInfer.jl`, compared with OLS.

Source: `EnvBRAN/rxinfer_exposure.md` (the `.ipynb` only survived as a
checkpoint; the `.md` export was the most complete version).

::: {.callout-note}
Ported from the RxInfer 2 API of the original (`datavar`, `inference`,
`initmarginals`) to RxInfer ≥ 3 (data as model arguments, `infer`,
`@initialization`). The model is unchanged.
:::

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using RxInfer, DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Distributions
```

```{julia}
DT = load_helix_clean();
enames   = vcat(HELIX_COVARIATES, helix_exposure_names(DT))
Exposure = Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, enames])
bw       = Vector{Float64}(DT.bw_zscore);
```

```{julia}
n = size(Exposure, 1)
m = size(Exposure, 2)

@model function multivariate_linear_regression(y, x, n, m)
    a ~ MvNormalMeanCovariance(zeros(m), diagm(ones(m)))
    b ~ NormalMeanVariance(0.0, 1.0)
    W ~ InverseWishart(n + 2, diageye(n))
    c ~ ones(n) * b
    z ~ x * a + c
    y ~ MvNormalMeanCovariance(z, W)
end
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
results = infer(
    model          = multivariate_linear_regression(n = n, m = m),
    data           = (y = bw, x = Exposure),
    initialization = @initialization(q(W) = InverseWishart(n + 2, diageye(n))),
    returnvars     = (a = KeepLast(), b = KeepLast(), W = KeepLast()),
    free_energy    = true,
    iterations     = 20,
    constraints    = MeanField()
)
```

Bethe free energy convergence (truncating the initial step):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
using Plots
plot(results.free_energy[2:end], title = "Bethe Free Energy convergence", label = nothing, size = (400, 300))
```

Posterior credible intervals of the exposure effects:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
as = rand(results.posteriors[:a], 10000)
DT_results = DataFrame(Variable = enames,
                       Mean   = vec(mean(as; dims = 2)),
                       CI0025 = [quantile(as[i, :], 0.025) for i in 1:m],
                       CI0975 = [quantile(as[i, :], 0.975) for i in 1:m])
DT_results.sig = credible_nonzero(DT_results.CI0025, DT_results.CI0975)
show(DT_results[DT_results.sig, :])
```

Normal approximation p-values from the posterior means/SDs:

```{julia}
#| eval: false
betas = vcat(mean(results.posteriors[:b]), mean(results.posteriors[:a]))
stds  = vcat(std(results.posteriors[:b]), sqrt.(diag(cov(results.posteriors[:a]))))
DT_bayes = DataFrame(Names = vcat("intercept", enames), beta = betas, std = stds,
                     p_value = cdf.(TDist(n - m), -abs.(betas ./ stds)))
show(DT_bayes[DT_bayes.p_value .< 0.05, :])
```

Comparison with OLS (`ols_summary`; `two_sided = false` reproduces the
one-sided p-values of the original notebook):

```{julia}
X_ols = hcat(ones(n), Exposure)
DT_inf = ols_summary(X_ols, bw, vcat("intercept", enames); two_sided = false)
show(DT_inf[DT_inf.p_value .< 0.05, :])
```
